summary: The St. Clair County Regional Educational Service Agency opposes limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, citing the cost impact on school districts. The Board opposes narrowing E-Rate eligibility scope, emphasizing the cost and operational impact on libraries and school districts. It urges the Commission to preserve current funding categories and maintain the discount matrix. The Board also supports preserving existing contracts and considering empirical data in any changes. The Board is led by Jeff Wine, supported by Jessica Totty, and has 4 ayes and 0 nays with 1 absent. The Board was adopted on 21st day of September, 2026. Motion by: Jeff
